selectedOriginals.caption: A view of Saltburn Pier taken from the pathway on the hillside.
selectedOriginals.inspection: 2011 full original individually inspected: shortened open-ended pier, about20 transverse trestles, three flanged iron uprights per row with outward-raked outer legs, longitudinal and transverse X rods, straight grey timber walkway, paired side bays and slightly widened open head. No surviving end shelter; historic lost length not reconstructed.

additionalInspected.caption: On the Pier
additionalInspected.inspection: 2015 full deck original individually inspected: black curved/flared posts, four white horizontal rails and white kickboards, long transverse grey timber planks, integral benches in side bays and central clear walkway. Looking shoreward, own low three-gable cream/burgundy arcade is distinct from cliff lift and neighboring larger three-gable building. People, bins and life rings excluded as movable/contextual.

additionalInspected.inspection: 2009 full native original individually inspected: flanged/collared pipe legs, diagonal upper brackets, crossed thin rods between successive rows and at transverse frames, triple members with outboard rake, long timber edge beams. Sand/water/tidal line and horses are not structure geometry.

additionalInspected.caption: Saltburn Pier. Taken from the top of the Cliff Lift.
additionalInspected.inspection: 2005 full native original individually inspected: aerial across cliff lift shows own arcade three distinct parallel pitched ranges, larger central gable and slate roofs/terracotta ridge crests; central entry canopy and two flanking projecting window bays; long narrow open pier with two pairs of side bays/open wider head. Neighboring lift stations excluded.

additionalInspected.caption: Pier at Saltburn Looking along the west side of Saltburn's refurbished pier.
additionalInspected.inspection: 2007 full native side original individually inspected: own arcade cream boarded wall with burgundy diagonal timber braces/plinth and pendant eaves, slate roof/turned finials, platform concrete beams and iron legs. Sea and exterior maintenance equipment excluded.

sources.inspection: Primary record read: surviving pier about207m,20 triple transverse trestles, flanged cast-iron pipe columns with outwards-raked outer feet and cross-tie rods; timber deck beams. Further shortening after1974 storms. Qualla flight text1250ft describes an earlier length and is not used as current length.

Primary entrance-building record read:1925 entertainment building with three promenade-facing gabled ranges, taller middle roof, diagonal timber framing, slate and perforated terracotta ridges/turned finials. Three shallow projecting bays: middle open entrance, outer glazed upper divisions; pendant eaves along sides. Integral pier gateway included, lift/neighbors excluded.

Council record read. Pending repair proposal concerns existing posts/plinths/panels; inspected existing elevation and site sheets are used as geometric evidence, not proposed future construction or approval.

Aerial actually inspected at two zoom levels: straight NNE surviving pier, two pairs of side viewing bays, widened open head with no roof, separate own three-range arcade and lower cliff-lift station across promenade. Generalized arcade map angle differs slightly from long pier axis; separate orientation retained.

scope: Surviving shortened iron pier, timber deck, paired side viewing bays/open end and integral three-gable entrance arcade; exclude cliff lift, neighboring shore buildings and lost offshore length/shelter.
limitations: Selected surviving restored2005–2015 exterior, cross-checked against existing2025/2026 council elevations and current aerial; fine bracket/flange/rail/bench/roof-crest profiles and unseen faces are original proportional estimates, not scans.

Original fixed-batch scope mistakenly mentioned end shelter; inspected originals/current aerial show an open end. Primary207m current pier agrees with mapped extent; story1250ft relates to earlier length. Integral1925 entrance arcade included; separate cliff lift/shops/neighboring buildings excluded.

Terrain/ground, support burial depths, tide/seabed and actual marine embedment remain unverified until independent review. Ground must remain unchanged. No source photo/drawing pixels embedded; no lost offshore head/shelter reconstructed.
